config.mcp_server.title: MCP Server
config.mcp_server.allowed_tools_desc: Only selected tools are exposed. An empty list exposes no tools. Select all stores the current names explicitly.
config.mcp_server.no_tools_warning: No tools are currently enabled. Enable tools in the Tools section first.
config.mcp_server.auth_warning: Authentication is disabled. Anyone with network access can call your tools.
config.mcp_server.disabled_desc: Enable the toggle to expose AuraGo tools via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for external agents.
config.mcp_server.info: Exposes AuraGo tools as a remote MCP server using Streamable HTTP transport. External AI agents can discover and call your tools over the network.
config.mcp_server.vscode_bridge_desc: Enables the IDE connection and authentication without changing tool permissions.
config.mcp_server.vscode_bridge_notice: An empty list now allows no tools, including existing IDE configurations. Select tools or explicitly add the recommendations, then save.
config.mcp_server.vscode_config_desc: Use this snippet to connect an MCP client to the live AuraGo instance.
config.mcp_server.vscode_token_hint: Generate a bearer token before connecting an external MCP client.
config.mcp_server.error_loading_vscode_b: Failed to load VS Code bridge info
config.mcp_server.general_desc: Enable the MCP server and configure basic settings.
config.mcp_server.connection_desc: Endpoint and authentication settings for the MCP server.
config.mcp_server.enabled_help: Exposes AuraGo's built-in MCP server endpoint.
config.mcp_server.require_auth_help: Requires clients to use an MCP access token before tools are exposed.
config.mcp_server.forced_by_bridge: Forced on by the VS Code bridge — turn the bridge off to change this.
config.mcp_server.forced_by_bridge_auth: Forced on by the VS Code bridge — authentication is required while the bridge is active.
config.mcp_server.bridge_forces_note: Enabling the bridge also forces the MCP server on and requires authentication.
config.mcp_server.preset_applied: Preset applied. Save to keep the tool selection.
config.mcp_server.endpoint_url_help: Address that MCP clients enter to connect to AuraGo's built-in server.
config.mcp_server.token_help: Bearer token for MCP clients. A newly generated token is shown only once; copy it right away.
